routes.summary: Whether the API and its database are working
The relays apps connect through and the oldest app version still served

200.description: The network settings. Cacheable for five minutes; apps keep the last copy they read for when the API cannot be reached.

429.description: Too many requests from this address.

routes.summary: A one-time value for a device to sign before it registers

200.description: The challenge, valid for two minutes.

routes.summary: Add a device to your account, or update it

200.description: The device was already yours and is updated.

routes.summary: Take one of your devices off your account

204.description: The device is no longer on your account.

routes.summary: One connection per device that pushes account events as they happen

101.description: The connection is open. The server sends a challenge; the device answers with hello within 10 seconds. Close codes: 4400 bad message, 4401 not signed in, 4403 revoked, 4408 no hello in time, 4409 replaced by a newer connection for the same device, 4429 too many messages, 1012 restarting, 1013 overloaded.

429.description: Too many connections from this address.

routes.summary: Delete your account and take every device off it

202.description: The account is deleted here. Repeating the call answers the same way.

403.description: Only the phone and web app may delete an account, after verifying the sign-in again in the last 10 minutes (message reverify).

routes.summary: Clerk telling the API a user was deleted in its dashboard

204.description: Handled, or not an event the API acts on.

401.description: The Svix signature is missing, wrong or too old.

503.description: The API has no webhook secret, so it accepts no webhooks.
